race.description: Muswellbrook Steel Supplies Rusty Spanner Sprint Hcp
race.comment: IRISH JIG (11) sets the standard after being beaten a neck by Blue Akoya in a Randwick Class 3, where he took over late and was caught only in the last bound. His previous Tamworth fourth also had merit after he was held up passing the 200m, and the easier company gives him the right platform from the rails draw. ANGIE'S SISTER (7) is the clear danger, coming through that same Randwick race when fourth, beaten just under a length, after a dominant four-length BM66 win at Dubbo. ENTERPRISE LEGEND (4) brings solid BM82 form, with a close Scone third behind Warrior For Peace, and his ability to handle all surfaces keep him in the mix with the 3kg claim. SARATOGA POWER (2) was beaten just under a length by SHIHAB at this track first-up and has a strong record at this track and distance. Back in good order and has the ratings to figure prominently.
